summary: Frontend-only regression on restructured /shop and new dedicated /shop/:slug routes. All 13 test areas verified end-to-end via Playwright on desktop (1920) and mobile (390). Shop lists 14 cards with counts (All14, Embossed3, Floral2, Minimal2, Foil2, Botanical2, Classic2, Duo1). Category pills update ?category= URL and filter; deep-link /shop?category=Foil pre-filters to 2. Sort dropdown works: price-asc first tile = The Lin (₹65), price-desc first tile = The Solene (₹135). Search 'elodie' → 1 invitation. Saved toggle present. Load-more reveals all 14. Product tile click navigates to /shop/:slug. Detail page shows breadcrumbs (home + shop), price, WhatsApp href (https://wa.me/910000...), share, favorite, thumbs, enlarge → gallery-lightbox opens and closes on Escape. Elodie has 3 variants; selecting variant-2 (Antique Silver) updates price to ₹130 as required. Duo Adelaide detail price = ₹190 (with '/ pair · 2 cards'); tile shows '₹190 /pair'. Similar section shows 4 cards. Recently-viewed strip appears on both detail and /shop, persists across reload (localStorage 'ewc-recent'); current product excluded from its own recently-viewed. /shop/does-not-exist renders product-not-found. All images loaded (naturalWidth > 0). Mobile: shop grid 2 cols, similar 2 cols, product detail stacks (1 col). No console errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: WHATSAPP_NUMBER is a placeholder ('910000000000') — must be replaced before launch (already documented in code as TODO).

Shop.jsx captures `recent` in useState initializer only once on mount; if a user navigates from detail → shop via SPA link, the strip won't refresh until reload. Consider refreshing on route re-mount or on window focus for consistency.
getRecentlyViewed uses raw ids that must exactly match card.id; slugify is only used for URLs. Works today but a rename of card.id would silently drop recents. Consider persisting slugs instead.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new testids from the restructure verified: sort-select, product-detail-page, detail-{price,whatsapp,share,favorite,enlarge}, similar-section, similar-card-<slug>, recently-viewed, recent-<slug>, breadcrumb-shop, product-not-found. Landing '/' regression not deeply retested but shop Header/Footer render on both /shop and /shop/:slug. WhatsApp number placeholder unchanged.
